components.About.MissionSection.heading: Sound teaching, carried to whoever is ready to learn.
components.About.MissionSection.paragrap: Darasaone was built for the reality of learning today: a student in Dar es Salaam, a teacher in Nairobi and a family in London studying the same course from a phone. We give teachers a place to publish real curricula and give students the structure, assessment and record that scattered links can never provide.
components.About.MissionSection.smallAlt: A teacher explaining a lesson to students in a bright classroom
components.About.MissionSection.largeAlt: Students collaborating with laptops in a sunlit study hall
